info.description:
Read-only business metrics from the ConnectHub analytics warehouse.

Every number comes from dbt models and Python analytics that the pipeline builds
and Great Expectations validates; definitions are in `docs/metric-definitions.md`.
Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents (`application/problem+json`).

Successful data responses carry a weak `ETag`; send it back in `If-None-Match` to get
`304 Not Modified` while the data is unchanged. Responses are cached per data version
(the last validated pipeline run, `meta.data_version`).
info.title: ConnectHub Analytics API

post.description:
Answers from the dashboard's own data. The model may only call the approved read-only tools;
every number in the answer is then checked against what those tools returned, and an answer
with a number that no tool result supports is withheld (`status: withheld`).

The server is stateless: send the conversation so far (user and assistant text only) each
time. 503 `analyst-not-configured` until the analyst is enabled and configured; 429 when the
per-client rate limit or the daily token budget is reached; 413 or 422 for a request that is
too large or malformed. The answer is plain text.

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first, alternating user and assistant, starting and ending with a user message. At most ANALYST_MAX_HISTORY_TURNS messages. The server stores nothing.

content.description: Plain text. Limits: ANALYST_MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS per user message.
content.title: Content

role.description: Only user and assistant are accepted. System, developer, tool and function messages are refused: the server writes its own instructions and tool results.
role.title: Role

messages.title: Messages
